title: Palindrome Problems
definition: A string that reads the same forwards and backwards. Solved optimally using a Two Pointer approach (start and end moving inwards) in O(N) time and O(1) space.
simpleExplanation: Checking if 'racecar' is spelled the exact same way backwards.

answers.question: **Basic:** Valid Palindrome (Two Pointers)
**Advanced:** Longest Palindromic Substring
